revision_note: The original finite-chart restriction is injective by literal Polynomial.toLaurent on the previously constructed finite basis. The same holds on the WHOLE infinity chart by actual Laurent inversion and the original raw overlap transition. Through the already proved full-open squares these detect the two original ambient restrictions. The original sheaf condition on the proved complete two-open cover then detects global sections on the full overlap. Every original global section lands in both the positive filtration and actual transition of negative filtration, hence in the finite-dimensional matching space. This proves finiteness of the literal global section module for its independently constructed structural Q action. The old derived H0-to-global-sections comparison is rational linear for the coefficient-induced original Ext action, proving genuine H0 finiteness. Conversely every matching Laurent vector supplies actual finite/infinity chart sections; their original whole-intersection equality is derived from the same coordinates, then original sheaf gluing supplies a genuine global section. Thus original global sections are Q-linearly equivalent to the actual matching space, with the map explicitly full-overlap restriction. Together with unchanged72r3 this proves actual H0/H1 finiteness and exact representative comparisons for every original line. There is no dimension-chosen equivalence, assumed line triviality, assumed section lifting or restricted-open cover. Uniform families, twisting bounds, degree/Riemann-Roch, represented Picard/Jacobian and the final arithmetic theorem remain separate. Hosted elaboration/audit are pending; no local Lean was run.
